name: windows-sfc
title: Check and repair system files (sfc /scannow)
description: Runs the System File Checker, which verifies every protected Windows file and replaces damaged ones from the local store. It takes 15 to 60 minutes with heavy disk use, and the repair runs in the TrustedInstaller service, so it cannot be stopped once started. The result is read from CBS.log, not from screen text.
measure: if ($rp) { Add-ArhWarning 'A servicing restart is pending: sfc may not be able to repair until after it' }
if (Get-Process -Name TiWorker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Add-ArhWarning 'Windows is installing updates now; sfc will wait for it' }
Set-ArhPlan $true 'Check every protected system file and repair damaged ones (15 to 60 minutes, heavy disk use)'
apply: if ($failed) { Add-ArhWarning "$failed protected system file(s) could not be repaired (DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth is the next step)" }

Add-ArhNote $(if (-not $verified) { 'CBS.log shows no completed verification for this run' } elseif ($repaired -or $failed) { "Repaired $repaired, could not repair $failed" } else { 'No integrity violations found' })
if ($repaired) { Add-ArhWarning 'A restart may be needed to finish the repairs' }
